name: Closer
description: Escalating pair conversations, playful to reflective. No winners; every tier is a stopping point.

welcome.message:
This isn't a quiz. There are no points and no winners.

You'll be paired up and answer the same question as your partner, privately. When everyone's done, you'll see each other's answers at the same moment.

You can pass on any question, anytime. Nobody will know.

tier1-intro.message:
Tier 1. Warm-up.

You have a partner, their name will appear on your screen. Three quick questions, just for fun.

t1q1.prompt: Window seat or aisle seat, and why?

t1q2.prompt: If our class had a mascot, what should it be?

t1q3.prompt: If you could teleport to any place for just one hour, where would you go?

tier2-intro.message:
Tier 2. A little deeper.

New partner, check your screen for who. Three questions about what matters to you.

t2q1.prompt: What's something you've changed your mind about in the last year?

t2q2.prompt: What do you think makes someone a good friend?

t2q3.prompt: What's a compliment you received that you still remember?

tier3-intro.message:
Tier 3. Reflective.

One more new partner. These questions are slower, take your time, and remember you can always pass.

t3q1.prompt: What's something you're proud of that you rarely get to talk about?

t3q2.prompt: If you could thank one person right now, who would it be and for what?

t3q3.prompt: What's a moment from this year you want to remember in ten years?

checkout.prompt: Last one, for the whole class: one word for how that felt.

checkout-share.template:
How that felt, in our words:

{{checkout.responses.list}}

end.message: You just had nine real conversations.
